title: gary.js configuration
description: Configuration for inline JSON, data-config files and Gary.init(). Unknown or invalid fields are ignored with a console warning.

preset.description: Name of a ready-made set of lines, scenes and triggers offered by the character (its manifest's "presets"). Options the page sets itself win over the preset.

packs.description: Line pools used for ambient chatter.

inOrder.description: Line pools whose lines are said in the order written, one per use; after the last line, the last line repeats.

lines.description: Line pools merged by name with the character's own pools (a pool given here replaces the character's pool of the same name).

vars.description: Values for {name} placeholders in lines. {site} defaults to the page's hostname.

triggers.description: Replaces the default triggers, or the preset's.

addTriggers.description: Rules added after the default triggers, or the preset's, instead of replacing them.

scenes.description: Named sequences of steps that triggers ("scene") and Gary.do(name) can play.

entrance.description: Scene played instead of the usual entrance. Start it with an "enter" step.

dropTo.description: After a drag: "floor" falls to the bottom of the screen, "here" lands where it was let go.

surfaces.description: CSS selector of page elements the character may wander onto and stand on. Elements with a data-gary-surface attribute always qualify.

y.description: Height of the usual entrance: the body's middle as a fraction of the screen height. Default: the bottom of the screen.

x.description: Ambient walks stay between these fractions of the screen width.

height.description: Rendered frame height in CSS px, overriding the character's default.

announce.description: Announce speech bubbles to screen readers.

ambient.description: Random walks, glances and chatter while idle.

pace.description: How often ambient behaviour happens. "busy" wanders a lot.

restAfter.description: Seconds without visitor input after which the idle animation pauses to save CPU. 0 never rests.

quality.description: Artwork sharpness when the character offers several image sizes: auto matches the screen, standard always loads the smallest images, high always the sharpest.

interrupted.description: Line or #pool said when a drag interrupts the scene; the scene then carries on.

sceneStep.description: One step with exactly one action: walkTo, say, play or wait.

walkTo.description: A CSS selector (walks to the element and stands on it), "floor", or a point on the screen as fractions { x, y } (y: the body's middle).

enter.description: Appears just outside this edge of the screen (start of a scene).

y.description: With enter: the body's middle as a fraction of the screen height (default 0.5).

on.description: With enter: walk in level with the first matching element that has room.

exit.description: Walks off this edge of the screen and stays away.

at.description: Where on the element to stop.

play.description: Clip role to play once, e.g. judge, judge.pointer, idle.variant.

distance.description: For "near": distance in CSS px between the pointer and the character (default 80).

say.description: A line, or #pool to pick from a line pool.

scene.description: Scene to play. With a list, each firing plays the next scene and the last one repeats.

group.description: Rules with the same group share one escalation step.

during.description: Only while this scene plays: shows the line without stopping the scene. Needs "say".
